auth: reuse existing authenticated own channel only; no credential acquisition/copy/mint or session replacement; unavailable principal returns HELD/DENIED
code_targets: existing broker read handler only if needed
exclusions: Source grant from diagnostics or registry
load_guard: supported provider-preserving code load is UNESTABLISHED; no reload/restart/recreation permitted now. Existing broker has no hot reload and recreates its socket on startup. New bytes alone cannot accept an existing caller.
maintenance_preconditions: preserve exact e400 and current incarnation/environment generation
preserve all other provider/users and unique state
retain listening FD/socket inode or prove unchanged exact-caller mapping without lifecycle substitution
retain all live hotfix provenance as tested superset
safe-deploy mandatory for any image recreate; health/rollback alone not provider preservation proof
next: existing e400 performs installed inert transport-probe once. Backend/deployment owner supplies exact authenticated own-read and provider-preserving loading manifest; otherwise held. No accepted caller command issued.
observation: transport_and_own_binding_verified only after authenticated transport observation and before/after caller/incarnation/generation/registration comparison; source_admission=false; no transferable lease
owner: existing backend authenticated MCP execution-stream principal and lifecycle/session/environment repositories; existing native client carries observations through its authenticated own channel
required_provenance: derive and recheck current task/workspace/session/incarnation/environment/generation/registration/slot/path server-side; task HMAC or caller-supplied identity/probe result is insufficient; original expected binding must be resolved from retained trusted evidence, not self-asserted receipt
rollback: atomic code restoration only where supported; any lifecycle recovery requires the separately reviewed preservation contract; no Source replay, secret reconstruction or new session; rollback candidate remains failed
tests_required: own e400 active/RUNNING read with normal accounting progress
foreign caller/sibling using same task HMAC denied
unavailable auth or incomplete receipt HELD
unknowns: provider-preserving code loader and complete protected-resource preservation manifest
